transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Arjun, I'm really upset. My internet has been dropping out every ten minutes and my latest bill is way higher than it should be.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you're experiencing these issues with your connection and your billing. I can certainly help you get this sorted out.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide me with your account number?
Customer: Yes, it is 60024878. My name is Vivek Brown and my phone number is 93101 48272.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Brown. I've accessed your account. Looking at the billing, I see the error in the charge. I guarantee you'll get a full refund on this.
Agent: I will now raise a refund request for the wrong charge to correct your balance.
Customer: I appreciate that. But what about the network? I can't work from home if the signal keeps cutting out.
Agent: I've run a diagnostic on your line and it shows some instability. I'm going to raise a network ticket right now to have our engineers investigate the local cabinet.
Customer: That's a relief. I was worried I'd have to spend hours on the phone again. Thank you for fixing this so quickly.
Agent: You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, I've requested your refund and opened a network ticket for your connection. Goodbye!
